title: Module 4: Dry Adhesion & Nanotech
description: Understanding the physics of the Gecko effect, Van der Waals forces, and the engineering of dry adhesives.

learning_objectives.statement: Explain the hierarchical seta-to-spatula structure of the gecko foot and why scale matters
Estimate total adhesive force from per-contact force using multiplication and area scaling
Translate the biological mechanism into a function-based engineering specification (preload, shear, release)
Evaluate a gecko-inspired dry adhesive against competing attachment methods for a given mission
Identify the conditions under which the clean-contact assumption breaks and holding force collapses

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
